task: Create a multivariate flag named "gift_wrap_copy" whose control value is "Start free trial", with two variations "Try it free" and "See plans". Each variation must get 50% of users in every environment. Leave the flag enabled.
finalText: DONE: Created multivariate flag `gift_wrap_copy` (feature 1063) with control value "Start free trial", variations "Try it free" and "See plans" at 50% each, enabled. Verified in both Development and Production that it is on with the 50/50 split.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith feature create --help; flagsmith config
flagsmith feature variant --help; flagsmith feature variant add --help 2>&1 | head -60; flagsmith feature list --help | head -30; flagsmith environment --help | head -30
flagsmith feature list --include-archived; flagsmith environment list; flagsmith feature get --help | head -20

flagsmith feature create gift_wrap_copy --value "Start free trial" --enabled --variants '[{"value":"Try it free","weight":50},{"value":"See plans","weight":50}]' && flagsmith feature get gift_wrap_copy && for e in [env-bea8a2e267d07642] [env-bd8bef49f28afe08]; do echo "== $e"; flagsmith -e $e feature get gift_wrap_copy; flagsmith -e $e feature variant list gift_wrap_copy; done

flagsmith -e [env-bd8bef49f28afe08] flag --help | head -12; flagsmith -e [env-bd8bef49f28afe08] flag list 2>/dev/null | grep -i gift; flagsmith -e [env-bea8a2e267d07642] flag list 2>/dev/null | grep -i gift
